body: The cause is that the http worker's thread context gets populated with the license warning by auditing in the IP filter here https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/eb6af0e6b549d0810d8b89791556bc791b766652/x-pack/plugin/security/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/security/transport/filter/IPFilter.java#L334, which is not guarded by the usual "preserve threadcontext inside try-with-resources" https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/eb6af0e6b549d0810d8b89791556bc791b766652/modules/transport-netty4/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/transport/netty4/AcceptChannelHandler.java#L33 , like, for example, authentication (validator) is https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/eb6af0e6b549d0810d8b89791556bc791b766652/modules/transport-netty4/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/http/netty4/Netty4HttpHeaderValidator.java#L138-L140
Thanks @tvernum for aiding with the investigation on this one!
We _should_ be protecting against this kind of thing in the network layers too - can you share a full stack trace to the point where the thread context pollution is happening?
Ok thanks, yeah I think we have to fix this in the `AcceptChannelHandler` then.
